article.headline: Roko Prkacin scores 28 and Penn State cruises past Canisius 97-57
article.description: — Roko Prkacin scored 28 points, Ivan Juric had a double-double, and Penn State rolled past Canisius 97-57 on Monday night in the season opener for both teams.
article.linkText: Roko Prkacin scores 28 and Penn State cruises past Canisius 97-57

categories.description: Canisius Golden Griffins @ Penn State Nittany Lions

event.description: Canisius Golden Griffins @ Penn State Nittany Lions

keywords: Canisius Golden Griffins @ Penn State Nittany Lions
article.story: UNIVERSITY PARK, Pa. -- — Roko Prkacin scored 28 points, Ivan Juric had a double-double, and Penn State rolled past Canisius 97-57 on Monday night in the season opener for both teams. Prkacin made 12 of 14 shots and 4 of 5 free throws. Juric scored 14 points and grabbed 15 rebounds. The Nittany Lions led by as many as 22 points in the first half, and it was 47-26 at the break. Prkacin led the way with 12 points, and Juric hauled in eight rebounds. Early in the second half, Prkacin outscored the Golden Griffins 12-2 over a 3-minute stretch as the Nittany Lions extended their lead to 66-35. The biggest lead was 96-54 in the final minute. Clinton Efinda led Canisius with 13 points, and Preist Ryan added 12. Josh Reed scored 12 points for Penn State. The Nittany Lions shot 55% and made 21 of 29 free throws (72%). The Nittany Lions have won all four previous meetings with Canisius, most recently earning a 97-67 victory in 2022. The Golden Griffins' roster is full of transfers and freshmen, with only one returning player who scored for them last year — Trevor Augustine, who scored four points last season. He did not score on Monday. Up next Canisius: vs. St. Bonaventure on Saturday.
